Copy packages by file system

Source: R/copy_packages.R
copy_packages.Rd

Copies package directories from their source libpath into a target library directory. Packages with no usable source path are skipped; missing source directories are reported as errors.

Usage

copy_packages(plan, target_lib, log_callback = NULL)

Arguments

plan

data.table with columns package, libpath, compiled.

target_lib

Character. Path to the target library root.

log_callback

Function or NULL. Called with a single string per event.

Value

data.table with columns package, status ("success", "skipped", or "error"), and message.
